sentences.text:
Pradeep Kumar Gupta And 4 Others vs State Of Up And 3
Others on 13 May, 2024

Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta
Bench: Manoj Kumar Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:85591-Db
Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 13148 of 2024
Petitioner :- Pradeep Kumar Gupta And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Pradeep Kumar Sharma,Punit Kumar Gupta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
Personal affidavit filed on behalf of respondent No.1, is taken on record.

2. The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to the respondents to pay compensation to them in accordance with the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Pradeep Kumar Gupta And 4 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95677428/
1 3.

entities.text: Pradeep Kumar Gupta And 4 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that the respondents had taken possession of their land for utilizing it for public purposes on basis of mutual settlement between the parties.
Although, land was taken in the year 2016 but the compensation amount as mutually agreed was not paid and hence, the instant petition.
4. On 24.04.2024, the following order was passed:

"1. Submission is that the respondents are not paying full compensation to the petitioners on the ground that the State has not made available requisite funds.
2. We call upon respondent No. 1 to file his personal affidavit and explain the delay in not allocating requisite funds despite the fact that the tenure holders had long been deprived of their land by construction of a canal.
3.

4. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Addl. Chief Standing Counsel will communicate the instant order to respondent No. 1 for immediate compliance."
5.

On matter being taken up today, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel Shri Suresh Singh has placed on record an affidavit of the Principal Secretary, Department of Irrigation and Water Resources, Govt. of U.P., Lucknow, in which, the stand taken is that the compensation amount payable to the petitioner has been approved on 09.05.2024.

entities.text: Department of Irrigation and Water Resources, Govt. of U.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Copy of the government order dated 09.05.2024 has been annexed along with the affidavit.
6. Shri Suresh Singh submits that the petitioner would be paid the entire amount as sanctioned within two weeks subject to the petitioners completing the formalities as may be required.

7. Having regard to the aforesaid statement of learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the compensation amount be paid to the petitioners within two weeks subject to the petitioners fulfilling the requirement as may be expected.
On receipt of the compensation amount, the petitioners will execute title documents in favour of the State as was agreed between the parties.

Mukesh Kr.
(Kshitij Shailendra,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
